# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

Yuva Nidhi (Unemployment Allowance for Graduates and Diploma Holders)
Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department (Department of Employment and Training), Government of Karnataka

Karnataka pays a monthly allowance to young people who finished a degree or diploma and still have no job six months after the result: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates and postgraduates, Rs.1,500 for diploma holders. It is paid for up to two years, or until you get a job or start further studies, whichever comes first. You apply on Seva Sindhu (now Seva One), and you must confirm on the portal every three months that you are still unemployed, or the payment stops.
Rs.3,000 a month for graduates, Rs.1,500 a month for diploma holders, for up to 2 years
Passed a degree, postgraduate degree or diploma from the 2022-23 academic year onward
No job (government or private) and not self-employed for 180 days after the result
Karnataka domicile: studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years, counting SSLC, PUC and the degree or diploma
Not studying further, not drawing an apprenticeship stipend, and not getting any other unemployment allowance
A bank account in your own name, seeded with Aadhaar
Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked to it for the OTP
Degree, postgraduate or diploma marks cards and the provisional or final certificate
SSLC and PUC marks cards, as proof of study in Karnataka
Bank passbook of an account in your own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Self-declaration that you are not employed or studying (made on the portal)
Your own Aadhaar. Your name, date of birth and photo are taken from it after the OTP.
Payment messages and the three-monthly declaration reminders come here.
Graduates and postgraduates get Rs.3,000; diploma holders get Rs.1,500. Choose what you actually passed.
The body that awarded the degree or diploma.
As printed on your final marks card.
The 180 days without a job are counted from this date. Apply only after they are over.
These prove that you studied in Karnataka.
Are you employed, self-employed or studying?
Answer truthfully. Money paid on a false answer is recovered.
Your own account, NPCI-seeded with Aadhaar, or the transfer fails.
Where you live. The district employment officer handles your file.
Wait until 180 days have passed since your result date, with no job and no further studies.

Open the Yuva Nidhi service on Seva One (sevaone.karnataka.gov.in), log in or register with your mobile number and OTP, and complete the Aadhaar e-KYC. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre can do this for you.
Fill in your qualification, register number, year of passing and SSLC and PUC details, upload the marks cards, and give your Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Submit and note the application number. The district employment officer checks your certificates; follow it with 'Yuvanidhi Application Status Check' on the portal.
Once approved, the allowance is paid into your account every month by DBT. The department may also ask you to register on the Kaushalkar skills portal for training.
Every three months, submit the 'Unemployment Self Declaration' on the portal. If you miss it, the payment stops until you submit it.
When you get a job or join a course, stop declaring. The allowance ends after two years in any case.
1902 — Karnataka guarantee schemes helpline; 080-22279954 / 87926 62814 / 87926 62816 — Seva Sindhu application and technical help
Gruha Jyothi (Free Electricity up to 200 Units)
Energy Department, Government of Karnataka, through the electricity supply companies (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM)

Karnataka gives every household free electricity up to its usual monthly use, as long as that stays within 200 units. Your free limit is your average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. Use within that limit and the bill is zero; use more and you pay only for the extra units; cross 200 units in a month and you pay the full bill for that month. You register once, free, by linking the house's electricity account to your Aadhaar. Owners and tenants can both apply.
Zero bill up to your free limit (average 2022-23 use + 10 units), up to 200 units a month
A domestic (house) electricity connection in Karnataka. Shops and other commercial use are not covered
Owner, tenant or family member living in the house. One connection per Aadhaar, and one connection per house
Monthly use must stay at or below 200 units. Above 200, the full bill is charged for that month
Free limit = average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. A new house or new connection with no 2022-23 record gets a fixed limit based on the state average of 53 units
Old unpaid electricity dues must be cleared. Homes on Bhagya Jyothi, Kutira Jyothi and Amrut Jyothi are included in Gruha Jyothi
Aadhaar card of the person applying
Latest electricity bill, for the ESCOM name and the Account ID (connection ID)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
The bill need not be in your name: tenants and family members choose their type in the form
Tenants: a rent agreement or other proof of living at that address, if the office asks for it
English or Kannada. The labels of the form change to the language you pick.
The company named at the top of your bill: BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM or Hukkeri Society.
The account or connection ID printed on your bill, not the meter number. The name and address then fill in from the ESCOM's records.
Comes from the ESCOM record. It may be the landlord's name or a late parent's name; that is fine.

Owner, Tenant, or Family member (for example, when the bill is in your father's name).
Your own Aadhaar. One Aadhaar can be linked to only one connection in the whole state.
Exactly as on your Aadhaar. The OTP check matches it.
The acknowledgement and later messages about the scheme come here.
You confirm the connection is used only for the house. Commercial use cancels the benefit, and the free amount is recovered with interest.
Keep your latest electricity bill ready and find the ESCOM name and the Account ID on it.

Open sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in, choose Gruha Jyothi and click to register. The form opens without any login. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre, or your ESCOM office, will also register you free.
Select your ESCOM, type the Account ID and check the name and address that appear. Choose Owner, Tenant or Family member, then enter your Aadhaar and verify it with the OTP.
Tick the declaration, submit, and note the acknowledgement number. You can check the status later on the Seva Sindhu 'Track Status' page.
From the next bill, your bill shows your free limit (eligible units). Within it the bill is zero; above it you pay only for the extra units; above 200 units you pay the whole bill.
Tenants moving house: use the Gruha Jyothi De-link option on the same portal to free your Aadhaar from the old connection, then register again at the new house.
If the bill is not zero, first check the eligible-units line on it, then call 1912 or visit the ESCOM sub-division office with your acknowledgement number.

Kerala Construction Workers Welfare Board Membership (Nirmana Thozhilali Kshemanidhi)
Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour and Skills Department, Government of Kerala

Membership for masons, carpenters, helpers, painters, electricians, plumbers and other building workers aged 18 to 59. Members pay Rs.50 a month and get a pension after 60, and help at childbirth and marriage, for children's education, medical treatment, disability and death. You join at the Board's district office with proof of age and of 90 days' construction work. The Board has about 20 lakh members but is short of money: in June 2026 the Labour Minister told the Assembly that pensions have been pending since June 2025.
Pension Rs.1,600 a month after 60, plus maternity, marriage, education, treatment and death aid
Aged 18 to 59 and working in building or other construction work in Kerala
Worked at least 90 days in construction work in the last 12 months
Pay the Rs.50 monthly subscription to keep the membership active; a break can stop your benefits
Pension: 60 or older with at least 5 years of active membership
Maternity aid: women members with at least 1 year of membership, for up to two deliveries
After a member's or pensioner's death, the nominee or spouse can claim the death benefit or family pension
Membership application form from the Board's district office
Age proof: birth certificate, school certificate or Aadhaar
Certificate of at least 90 days' construction work in the last 12 months, from your employer or contractor
Copy of a bank passbook in the worker's own name
Passport-size photos and your nominee's details
For each benefit later: the Board's claim form for it (Form 34 for pension, Form 38 for disability pension, Form 36 for death benefit) with the Welfare Fund ID card and passbook

The district office of the Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (District Executive Officer) in your district. You get a Welfare Fund ID card and passbook. Pay Rs.50 every month so the membership stays active.

For a benefit such as maternity, marriage or treatment aid, apply at the same office on the Board's form for it, with the ID card and passbook, soon after the event; after 90 days you must explain the delay.

At 60, with 5 years of active membership, apply for the pension on Form 34 with the ID card, passbook, bank passbook copy and Aadhaar. It is paid into your bank, but payments are running many months late now.
0471-2337941 — Board head office, Thiruvananthapuram; or the Board's district office in your district
State Health Agency Kerala, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Kerala

Kerala's free health cover, run together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. About 42 lakh poorer families get treatment worth up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at about 180 government and 365 private empanelled hospitals. The KASP card is made at the KASP help desk of an empanelled hospital or at an Akshaya centre after an Aadhaar check. The new government plans to merge KASP into a bigger Oommen Chandy Health Insurance Scheme, but until that is notified KASP cards keep working as before.
Up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
Families that had an RSBY or CHIS health card in 2018-19, and families on the PM-JAY list (SECC 2011), including those who got the letter from the Prime Minister
About 42 lakh families, the poorest 40% of Kerala. Every member is covered, whatever the age or the size of the family
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one. Costs for 3 days before admission and 15 days after discharge are included
Other families cannot join now. New names are added only when the government announces it

A seriously ill patient from a poor family that is not in KASP can ask the same hospital desk about the Karunya Benevolent Fund: Rs.2 lakh for illnesses such as cancer and heart disease, Rs.3 lakh for kidney disease
Aadhaar card of every family member who needs a card
Old RSBY or CHIS card, or the letter from the Prime Minister, if you have one
At admission: the KASP card (or its number) and the patient's Aadhaar

The KASP (PM-JAY) help desk at any empanelled government or private hospital, such as a medical college, district or taluk hospital, or any Akshaya e-Kendra. Take the Aadhaar card of every member who needs a card, the ration card and a mobile phone. There is no paper form: the staff search your family on the computer and check each member's Aadhaar.
The ration card finds the whole family at once. If nothing comes up, the staff try with your Aadhaar number.
The 10-digit number printed on your ration card.

Each member is done one by one. Check the name and age before the card is printed.
The Aadhaar of the member whose card is being made now.

Face the camera straight, without cap or dark glasses.

Check if your family is covered: ask at an Akshaya centre or a hospital KASP desk, or call DISHA on 1056.

When treatment is needed, go to an empanelled hospital and show the KASP card and Aadhaar at the KASP counter before admission.
The hospital takes approval from the State Health Agency. Medicines, tests, surgery, ICU, room and food in the package are free; do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
If the hospital refuses or asks you to pay, call DISHA 1056 or the State Health Agency before paying.
Not on the list but seriously ill and poor? Ask the same desk how to apply to the Karunya Benevolent Fund.

Social Security Pension (Kshema Pension / Sevana Pension)
Local Self Government Department and Finance Department, Government of Kerala, through grama panchayats, municipalities and corporations

Kerala's monthly welfare pension, Rs.2,000 since November 2025, for poor elderly people, widows, persons with disabilities, unmarried women over 50 and old agricultural labourers. About 52 lakh people get it. Your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation takes the paper form, checks your case and must decide within 45 days. The money comes every month to your bank account, or a co-operative bank agent hands it over at your home. The new government has promised to raise it to Rs.3,000, but no date has been fixed yet.
Rs.2,000 a month
Family income not above Rs.1 lakh a year, and not an income tax payer
Old age pension: 60 or above. Agricultural labourer pension: 60 or above, at least 10 years as a farm labourer and a member of the Agricultural Workers' Welfare Fund
Widow pension: widows who have not remarried, and women of 50 or more whose husband has been missing or has left them for over 7 years. Unmarried women's pension: unmarried women aged 50 or more
Disability pension: persons with 40% or more disability certified by a medical board

Not eligible: land over 2 acres (except ST families), a car over 1000 cc that is not a taxi, a concrete house over 2,000 sq ft with modern flooring, or a government or PSU service or family pension (ex-gratia or NPS pension up to Rs.4,000 is allowed)
Only one social security pension per person (except persons with disability), applied for in the local body where you live permanently
Age proof: school certificate, birth certificate, church or mosque record, voter ID or Aadhaar
Income certificate from the Village Office

Aadhaar card and voter ID card (copy of both sides)
Ration card (copy of the first page and the page with your name)
Bank passbook copy, if you want the pension in a bank
Widows: husband's death certificate. Disability pension: medical board disability certificate
EPF passbook, only if you get an EPF pension below Rs.4,000
